struggle.subtitle: You're qualified, driven, and ready. Yet, the cycle repeats: effort, rejection, doubt. Let's break free from what's holding you back.

blackHole.title: The Resume Black Hole
blackHole.text: Endless applications, deafening silence. Feel like your resume vanishes? It's a common frustration.

timeSink.title: The Time Sink
timeSink.text: Constantly tweaking resumes, writing cover letters... Job searching shouldn't consume your entire life.

visibility.title: The Visibility Problem
visibility.text: Generic resume? No portfolio? Struggling to showcase your unique skills and stand out from the crowd?

atsGauntlet.title: The ATS Gauntlet
atsGauntlet.text: Confused by keywords? Worried about formatting? Getting past the bots feels like a losing battle.

missingOut.title: Don't Let Outdated Tactics Cost You
missingOut.text: A generic application isn't enough in {year}. Standout portfolios, targeted resumes, and showcasing your unique value are essential. Are your materials truly competitive?

features.title: Your New Edge:
features.subtitle: CareerFlow AI isn't just another tool. It's your intelligent partner, designed to amplify your strengths and navigate the complexities of the modern job market.

hyperPersonalized.title: Hyper-Personalized AI Drafts
hyperPersonalized.text: AI analyzes job descriptions AND your profile to craft unique, targeted resumes & letters in seconds. Say goodbye to generic!

conquerAts.title: Conquer the ATS
conquerAts.text: Optimized formatting, keyword analysis, and a FREE instant ATS score checker ensure you pass the bots.

ownCorner.title: Your Own Corner of the Web
ownCorner.text: Generate a stunning, professional website & portfolio from your resume. Easily edit with AI, share instantly.

aiEditing.title: AI Editing Magic Wand
aiEditing.text: Need a section stronger? More concise? Just ask the AI. Edit anything in real-time with simple prompts. ✨

howItWorks.title: AI Is Your Co-Pilot, Not the Pilot
howItWorks.subtitle: Forget robotic templates. We blend AI's speed with your unique voice. You're always in control, crafting applications that are both effective and authentically *you*.

input.title: Input & Context
input.text: Provide your details, experiences, and the target job/scholarship description. Give the AI the fuel it needs.

aiMagic.title: AI Magic Drafts
aiMagic.text: Our AI generates tailored first drafts of resumes, letters, and website content in moments, optimized for ATS and impact.

refine.title: Refine & Personalize
refine.text: Use intuitive tools and AI prompts ('Make this sound more confident') to polish, add your unique flair, and make it perfect.

pricing.title: Simple Plans, Powerful Results
pricing.subtitle: Choose the plan that fits your journey. Start free, upgrade anytime. No hidden fees.
